subject: Clarify auto-renew evidence and termination-for-convenience (MSA/Order Form)
messages:
From: John Park <john.park@acme.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Meridian Law - Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@meridianlaw.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Auto-renew proof & TFC wording — what evidence will Acme need?

Hi Stephanie / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement has one outstanding gating item before we can sign the order form: we need to document what "proof" Redwood will provide to support an auto-renew (audit trail / notification evidence) and we want clarity on the Termination for Convenience (TFC) mechanics — specifically:

- What constitutes a valid "notice" to trigger non-renewal (email vs portal vs both)?
- Can the notice window be 60 days instead of 90 for our case?
- If TFC is exercised, what operational handoff and data export commitments are in the SOW?

Can you share a short, customer-facing summary we can give procurement + legal? Sarah at Meridian (cc'd) will track redline comments on the MSA.

Appreciate it — John
John Park
Head of Procurement, Acme Corporation
[Attachment: Acme-SLA-requirements.pdf (pdf)]

----
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: John Park <john.park@acme.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Meridian Law - Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@meridianlaw.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Auto-renew proof & TFC wording — what evidence will Acme need?

John — thanks for the clear list. I put together an internal/customer-friendly summary and a small MAP (mutual action plan) so procurement and legal have a concrete path to sign-off. High level:

1) Notice mechanics: Redwood will accept non-renewal notices sent either via the account owner's email on file (with read receipt) OR via the Redwood Console's contract settings page (audit log entry). We recommend both for enterprise deals.

2) Evidence of notice: a) timestamped audit log entry from the Console showing the opt-out action OR b) an email with a delivery/read receipt sent to contracts@redwood.ai. Audit logs will include IP + user id + timestamp.

3) Notice window: we can accept a 60-day window for this order form (one-time concession) if Acme agrees to the mutual action plan and the order form includes the 60-day value as an explicit override to the MSA.

4) TFC operational handoff: Redwood will provide export of customer data (S3-compatible bundle), basic handover doc, and 30 days of post-termination access to the Console for data extraction. If Acme requires extended retention/escrow, we can scope that as an add-on.

I've attached a draft MSA excerpt with suggested language and an internal legal note on the evidence types. Markus — can you review the highlighted options and confirm we can commit to the 60-day concession when documented in the OF?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MSA-TFC-draft-20270510.docx (docx)]

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, John Park <john.park@acme.com>, Meridian Law - Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@meridianlaw.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Auto-renew proof & TFC wording — legal redline guidance

Thanks, Stephanie. Quick legal view and recommended edits:

- Notice: we prefer the language to require written notice "sent to contracts@redwood.ai and via the Redwood Console" to avoid ambiguity; however, for enterprise customers we'll accept a single-channel notice if the OF explicitly names the channel (e.g., "60-day notice via the Console").

- Evidence: the audit log approach is acceptable. We should include the following sentence in section 7.2: "Customer's election to opt out of renewal shall be evidenced either by a timestamped audit-log entry recorded by Redwood's Console or by a delivered email to contracts@redwood.ai with an automated delivery receipt."

- 60-day concession: acceptable as a limited override; we need to add a provision that it applies only to this order form and that the MSA default remains 90 days for future orders.

- TFC handoff: confirm the export format (S3 tarball) and add an operational runbook reference (Appendix B). Also propose a clause limiting Redwood's post-termination support to 30 days unless otherwise purchased.

I'll attach a PDF with inline comments on the MSA excerpt. Once Acme confirms the OF will include the 60-day override, we can lock language and prepare the DocuSign package.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redline_msao_tfc_comments.pdf (pdf)]
